audience: strata managers who look up plans, lots, levies and receivables in Urbanise Strata

useCases.title: Check the levy ledger of one lot
useCases.text: Find the lot by its number in a plan. Read the owner details and the levy ledger with its charges and payments.

useCases.title: Review the levy summary of a plan
useCases.text: Open the details of a plan, then read its levy summary with the totals and balances for the whole plan.

useCases.title: Find unpaid receivable invoices
useCases.text: List the receivable invoices of the client, filtered by plan, lot, payment status or invoice date. Read the manager of the plan to know who to contact.

useCases.title: Find an owner across all plans
useCases.text: Search lots and owners across the client's plans by lot or owner text. Open a lot to see its owner and levy details.

useCases.title: Prepare a committee and insurance review
useCases.text: List the committee members and the insurance policies of one plan. Read the work order instructions set for the same plan.
